purpose: Executable Radboud-style PANDA fine-mask contract; Gleason architecture rendering is downstream.

constraints.mask_statement: Require provider, preprocessing revision, and label-map digest; reject a profile whose provider/signature is not the certified Radboud-style fine contract.
known_limitations: The current checker validates field presence and ID signature; certified provider-value/digest matching is still pending.

constraints.mask_statement: Preserve every zero pixel exactly; background/unknown/unannotated regions cannot seed, receive, bridge, or be filled by tumor, stroma, or benign epithelium.
generation_handoff: Do not inpaint protected zero pixels.
known_limitations: Some zero pixels may contain real tissue, but the annotation contract still cannot authorize editing them.

constraints.mask_statement: Do not convert Gleason 3, 4, and 5 or benign epithelium into one another during a burden edit; only declared source pixels may change to the selected target fine ID.
generation_handoff: Generate pattern-appropriate architecture for the retained fine ID; the mask only guarantees ID preservation.
known_limitations: A fine ID does not encode individual gland, lumen, or cribriform topology.

constraints.mask_statement: Do not bridge separate Gleason components, fill zero/unknown gaps, create islands, split sources, merge targets, or fill holes to make sparse annotation look complete.
known_limitations: Annotation repair is a separate task and remains unsupported.
